study: temporal repair sub-study (separate from Stage M; authorized irrespective of the Stage M gate)
status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY NEW TEMPORAL FIT ON STUDY DATA
inputs_unchanged: Week 20 Track 2 checkpoints: NEW DEV repeats 1-2, ten folds, B16/40/80, Week 19 shared label-blind paid prefixes; K = 360 bin means from the training-only rule; native maxima as extra training points; planned horizon from scheduled settings; observed window = recording end; no stretching or tail filling

repairs.svgp: NGD (lr 0.1) on the natural variational distribution + Adam (lr 0.01) on hyperparameters and inducing locations; lr halved at 5000 and 10000; stop on training evidence only (probe ELBO relative change <= 5e-4 and probe-mean RMS change <= 5e-3 for 3 consecutive 250-iteration checks, 1000 <= iterations <= 20000); identical protocol for M = 400 (30 checkpoints) and M = 800 (the ten B40 checkpoints)
repairs.functional: rank-3 probabilistic PCA with missing data (EM; coefficient prior N(0, I), exact per-run posterior on observed bins; EM tol 1e-9 relative log likelihood, max 3000 iterations), orthogonal rotation, then one GP per coefficient with per-run noise = that run's coefficient posterior variance (sklearn, ConstantKernel x Matern-3/2 ARD + White, alpha = posterior variance)

threads: SVGP: 3 torch threads; functional: 1 BLAS thread; at most 4 in total
metrics: unchanged Week 20 Track 2 definitions: trajectory RMSE/MAE on observed bins, 50/90 % pointwise coverage and width (latent + noise), A = median of posterior maxima over the planned horizon (like-for-like runs), A 90 % interval, signed and absolute A error, argmax timing error, time above u_ref error, P(max > u_ref) Brier vs the event; plus conditioning, convergence, inducing sensitivity and runtime

hypotheses.TR-H1_svgp_convergence_rmse: The converged SVGP (svgp_ngd_M400) has lower mean trajectory RMSE than the frozen 2000-iteration SVGP at every budget. Direction from Week 20 T2-PS1 (6000 iterations: -23 % on five checkpoints). Magnitude not committed.
hypotheses.TR-H2_svgp_convergence_A: The converged SVGP has lower median |A error| than the frozen SVGP at B40 and B80, but stays above the scalar A GP. Direction from T2-PS1 (A error 60 -> 45 um, scalar 5.0 um on the same rows).
hypotheses.TR-H3_inducing_sensitivity: Under equal convergence effort, the RMS difference of the predictive mean between M=400 and M=800 at B40 is smaller than under the frozen protocol (0.167 at ckpt_r1_f1_B40). Direction only.
hypotheses.TR-H4_functional_conditioning: The PPCA functional model has no exploding coefficients (max |posterior-mean coefficient| below 10 at every checkpoint) and lower mean trajectory RMSE than the frozen functional model at every budget. Basis: controlled staircase validation and the Week 20 diagnosis.
hypotheses.TR-H5_model_ranking: PPCA functional vs converged SVGP: no directional expectation.
hypotheses.TR-H6_A_gap: Neither repaired temporal model reaches the scalar A GP's median |A error| at B40 or B80 (Week 20: about 10x gap).
hypotheses.TR-H7_calibration: No numerical expectation for 50 %/90 % pointwise coverage; reported with widths.
